summary.text: Sam Jones, a Democrat, has represented District 99 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2018 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born and raised in Mobile, Alabama, and served in the U.S. Navy during the Vietnam War.

He later served as executive director of Mobile Community Action, was elected to the Mobile County Commission and became president of the Alabama County Commission Association, and was later elected mayor of Mobile.
